defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: allow colon in webhook header value (#1666)

printf %s '' | base64 -d > config/webhook_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestExtractHeaders)$' ./config >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi
